text:
[RFCS.7a.2] The `FactWithdraw` body carries a **closed** `Cause` enum,
on the `TrapKind` precedent ([LERR.1.4.9]) — so a consumer branches on a
cause rather than string-matching, and a cause added without a raiser is
visible:

| value | raised by |
|---|---|
| `JUSTIFIER_ENDED` | the truth-maintenance cascade — the last justifier LHS stopped matching |
| `TTL_EXPIRED` | the pump TTL sweep |
| `SUPERSEDED` | **supersedure generally** — a successor took the fact's place under the same identity. Both an identity upsert replacing a keyed fact ([LFAC.2.5.1]) and an `as`-keyed re-fire superseding a prior timer, response fact, `CallError` or capture fact ([LRST.2.2]) |
| `SYNTHETIC_DISCHARGED` | a fact **the lowering** created to carry a deferred action, withdrawn because that action has run or an answer has ended it — the `after`-clause timer fact ([LTAC.3.1]) dropped at end-of-RHS, the `timeout`-clause timer fact dropped at end-of-RHS ([LCCO.7.2]) or by an answer ([LCCO.7.6]), and the capture-corr facts ([LRST.4]). Never an author fact, and never recorded: every fact it labels is compiler-owned ([RFCS.6a.5]) |
| `AUTHOR_WITHDRAWN` | a rule's own `withdraw <binding>` action ([LSCO.4.5.9], [LCYC.3.1.1]) — the one cause here where an author fact leaves by the author's own instruction, always `scope explicit` |
| `ACTIVATION_COMPLETED` | a fact an activation emitted into a `scope activation` schema, withdrawn because the activation completed ([LSCP.2.4.1]): at the synchronous end of its RHS, or when the token fact carrying its last deferred path was discharged or superseded. An author fact, by the author's declaration of the scope |

The engine **must** set the cause of each `FactWithdraw` it records where the
withdrawal originates, and **must not** record one whose cause is
`CAUSE_UNSPECIFIED`. Several origins reach one retraction path, so a cause
computed on that path would label them all alike.

**The cause binds a recorded withdrawal only.** A compiler-owned fact's
withdrawal is never recorded ([RFCS.6a.5]), so no cause the engine gives it
reaches any reader, and none binds. `SYNTHETIC_DISCHARGED` is the member that
names such a withdrawal. A runtime may label one by another member inside the
engine, as when a `timeout` sibling releases its call's capture fact by
correlation ([LCCO.7.2]).

**Every member has a raiser**, as every `TrapKind` member has. Number 4 is
reserved: the engine has no concept of a disconnected adapter ([RARC.14.5]),
so no withdrawal has that cause. A member added to a closed enum breaks a
reader that switches on it, so a new cause is a format change ([LDET.1.10]).

A reader **must** accept a `FactWithdraw` whose cause the enum does not hold,
the reserved 4 included, and carry the number. The atom is compare class
([RFCS.7a.3]), so an unknown cause is a difference the comparison finds, not a
decode error.
